decision.observation: The screen is solid dark gray with no HUD. In the previous frame the car was at 46 mph on dark grass left of the road, where the road bends right. Holding W carried it off-road, which triggered this reset.
decision.hypothesis: This is the off-road reset transition. Earlier ones cleared on their own after a few seconds, whatever keys were pressed, so waiting should bring back the game view with the car respawned on the road.
decision.memory: Lesson: before holding W, check that the car is actually on the tarmac. Last frame it was on grass left of a right bend, and it needed a W+D tap instead. The bottom HUD (number plus dots) is most likely gear plus a rev indicator, not checkpoints: '3' was shown at 46 mph. Black reset screens last several seconds and recover on their own, so wait instead of spamming keys. Each one costs about 5-10 s of timer.
